DAVV, Indore
More than 19 years of teaching experience.
Visiting Scientist at Paul Scherrer Institute, Switzerland during July-December 2004.
Ph.D. from DAVV Indore while working at UGC-DAE CSR, Indore (1998 -2004) Thesis Title: “Study of Thermal Behavior in Thin Film Multilayers”

My research interests are in the field of nano scaled thin films and multilayers. The phenomenon under investigation is: growth of thin films using reactive sputtering, tailoring of magnetic, optical and mechanical properties and the structure of the interface in thin film multilayers.
